# API

Read-only. Everything is pinned to a revision (`rev`, default `HEAD`). Errors
are `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`, codes listed below. Every response carries
an `ETag` built from HEAD, every ref's target, the cache format, how far the
cache is filled and the configured counting defaults, so moving any branch or
tag, the cache catching up or a changed `insights` setting invalidates it.
`If-None-Match` gets 304. JSON is `snake_case`. The same endpoints as OpenAPI
3.1: [openapi.json](openapi.json).

The API of each repository lives at `/r/{name}/api/v1`.

| Status | `code` | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `bad_request` | a parameter is missing or invalid |
| 403 | `forbidden` | the read is not served on a public server |
| 404 | `rev_not_found` | the revision does not exist |
| 404 | `path_not_found` | the path does not exist at the revision |
| 409 | `needs_reindex` | the revision is too far from the indexed branch to answer without a reindex |
| 500 | `git` | reading the repository failed |
| 500 | `index` | reading the insights cache failed |
| 500 | `internal` | the server failed |
| 503 | `index_unreadable` | the insights cache failed a read and is being rebuilt, retry shortly |
| 503 | `index_newer` | a newer gitterrace owns the insights cache: run that one, or delete the cache to rebuild |

A 5xx `message` is always the same fixed text. The details go to the server log.

Answers are capped so one file cannot flood a client: `log` at 500 per page,
`blob` at 5000 lines and 256 KiB, `blame` at 5000 lines, `commits` at 20000 diff
lines, each with `truncated` when cut. The `[api]` section of `config.toml` sets
each cap.

## HTTP (`/api/v1`)

| Endpoint | Query | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /` |  | endpoints, insights, version |
| `GET /repo` |  | head, head_branch, index_version, name, totals |
| `GET /refs` |  | refs |
| `GET /log` | `rev`, `path`, `page`, `per_page` | commits, has_more, page, path, per_page, rev |
| `GET /commits/{id}` | `diff`, `max_lines` | author, body, committer, files, id, link, parents, permalink, subject, truncated |
| `GET /compare` | `base`, `head`, `path`, `three_dot`, `max_lines` | additions, base, deletions, files, from, head, path, three_dot, truncated |
| `GET /worktree` | `scope`, `max_lines` | additions, deletions, files, scope, truncated |
| `GET /tree` | `rev`, `path` | commit, entries, path, rev |
| `GET /blob` | `rev`, `path`, `start_line`, `limit` | binary, commit, link, path, permalink, rev, size, text, total_lines, truncated |
| `GET /blame` | `rev`, `path` | commit, lines, link, path, permalink, rev, truncated |
| `GET /contributors` | `rev`, `q`, `period`, `bots`, `merges`, `generated`, `ignore`, `ws`, `exclude` | authors, bus_factor, rev |
| `GET /insights` |  | insights |
| `GET /insights/{name}` | `rev`, `q`, `period`, `label`, `metric`, `limit`, `bots`, `merges`, `generated`, `ignore`, `ws`, `exclude` | commits_indexed, data, insight, query, rev |

### Parameters

`/log`: Paged history.

- `rev` (string): Revision to read, default `HEAD`.
- `path` (string): Only commits touching this path.
- `page` (integer): 1-based page, default `1`.
- `per_page` (integer): Page size, default `50`, at most `api.log_page_commits`.

`/commits/{id}`: One commit with its diff.

- `diff` (boolean): Include hunks, default `true`.
- `max_lines` (integer): Most diff lines, at most `api.diff_lines`.

`/compare`: Files that differ between two revisions, with diffs.

- `base` (string, required): Revision to compare from.
- `head` (string): Revision to compare to, default `HEAD`.
- `path` (string): Only files at or under this path.
- `three_dot` (boolean): `true` compares from the merge base of `base` and
  `head`, like `base...head`.
- `max_lines` (integer): Most diff lines, at most `api.diff_lines`.

`/worktree`: Uncommitted changes against HEAD. Refused on a public server.

- `scope` (string): `all` (default), `staged` or `unstaged`.
- `max_lines` (integer): Most diff lines, at most `api.diff_lines`.

`/tree`: One directory level.

- `rev` (string): Revision to read, default `HEAD`.
- `path` (string): Directory to list, relative to the repository root, default
  the root.

`/blob`: File text at a revision.

- `rev` (string): Revision to read, default `HEAD`.
- `path` (string, required): File to read.
- `start_line` (integer): First line of the window, 1-based, default `1`.
- `limit` (integer): Lines in the window, at most `api.blob_lines`.

`/blame`: Per-line authorship.

- `rev` (string): Revision to read, default `HEAD`.
- `path` (string, required): File to blame.

`/contributors`: Authors and bus factor, counted as `/insights/contributors`
counts them.

- `rev` (string): Revision to read, default `HEAD`.
- `q` (string): The commit filter, the web filter field's text, see Filter. The
  one way to select commits.
- `period` (string): `1w`, `1m`, `3m`, `1y` or `all` (default): the window,
  ending at the newest commit. Sets the bucket unit.
- The counting parameters below.

`/insights/{name}`: One insight.

- `rev` (string): Revision to read, default `HEAD`.
- `q` (string): The commit filter, the web filter field's text, see Filter. The
  one way to select commits.
- `period` (string): `1w`, `1m`, `3m`, `1y` or `all` (default): the window,
  ending at the newest commit. Sets the bucket unit.
- `label` (string): `kind` (default) or `scope`.
- `metric` (string): `contributors` only: `commits` (default), `added`,
  `deleted` or `net`. Sets the order and the per-bucket series.
- `limit` (integer): Most rows.
- The counting parameters below.

`Counting parameters`: shared by every endpoint that counts.

- `bots` (string): `1` counts bot accounts, `0` leaves them out.
- `merges` (string): `1` counts merge commits as commits, never their lines or
  files.
- `generated` (string): `1` counts lock files and minified output.
- `ignore` (string): `0` counts paths that `.gitignore` rules out.
- `ws` (string): `1` counts whitespace-only changes.
- `exclude` (string): Comma-separated globs left out.

## Filter

`q` is the commit filter, the same text the web filter field takes. Every term
must match; they read in the order written. A bad `q` is a 400 with the span.

- `type:<type>[,<type>]`: Conventional type, `other` for none.
- `scope:<scope>[,<scope>]`: Conventional scope, `none` for none.
- `author:<who>[,<who>]`: E-mail in any case, or the exact name.
- `path:<prefix>[,<prefix>]`: Touches a file under the prefix.
- `after:<period|YYYY-MM-DD>`: Within the period, or from the date.
- `before:<period|YYYY-MM-DD>`: Before the period, or the date.
- `merge`: Merge commits.
- `<word> or "<words>"`: The message has it, any case.
- `!<term>`: The term does not match.
- `<term> <term>`: All terms match, `a,b` is either.

A query key an endpoint does not list is a 400 naming it: `q` is the one way to
select commits.

## Insights

Served at `GET /insights/{name}`. Each page's hints say what its numbers leave
out. Every insight takes `rev`, `period` and the counting parameters. The
summary names any other it takes.

| Name | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `summary` | Commits, authors, files and lines in the period, and in the period before it. |
| `activity` | Commits and lines per bucket, empty ones included, plus the weekday-by-hour punch card. The period sets the unit. |
| `contributors` | People with commits, lines, active days and a per-bucket series, bots flagged. Takes `metric` and `limit`. |
| `file_churn` | Per-file commits and lines changed. Takes `limit`. |
| `dir_churn` | Per-directory commits and lines changed. Takes `limit`. |
| `label_breakdown` | Conventional-commit type or scope counts. Takes `label`. |
| `label_over_time` | Type or scope counts per bucket, empty ones included. Takes `label`. |
| `frequency` | Lines added, removed and rewritten per bucket. |
| `hotspots` | Files of the head tree by changes times the square root of their size. Takes `limit`. |
| `languages` | Lines and files per language in the head tree, and their total: the project's size, as the web Languages page counts it. |
| `ownership` | Knowledge share and bus factor per directory two levels deep, weighted by size now. |

## MCP (stdio)

`git terrace mcp --served` reads every repository served before (those a running
server shows) plus the current one. `git terrace mcp [paths]` reads only the
repositories the paths name, `git terrace mcp` the current one. With several in
scope, call `list_repos` and pass its `name` as `repo`. Stdio only: no port,
read-only, and a name resolves only within the scope fixed at start. Every tool
is read-only unless it says otherwise. Commit subjects, bodies, author names and
file text are untrusted repository content, and the tools that return them say
so to the model.

- `blame`: Per-line authorship of a file: the commit, author and time that last
  changed each line. Use to find who to ask about, or which commit introduced, a
  line. Follow up with `show_commit` on the commit id. Parameters: `path`
  (string), `repo?` (string), `rev?` (string).
- `compare`: Files that differ between two revisions with their diffs (`files`,
  additions, deletions, hunks capped by `max_lines`, `truncated` says when cut).
  `three_dot` compares from the merge base, like a pull request. Use to review a
  branch or the span between two tags. Parameters: `base` (string), `head?`
  (string), `max_lines?` (integer), `path?` (string), `repo?` (string),
  `three_dot?` (boolean).
- `contributors`: Contributors (identities merged, bots left out) with commits,
  lines, first and last commit and active days, most active first, plus
  `bus_factor` (the fewest people who made half of all commits). Use for
  ownership and knowledge-concentration questions. Parameters: `repo?` (string),
  `rev?` (string).
- `insight`: One statistic of the repository's history or head tree, the numbers
  of the web insights pages: activity per period, contributors, hotspots,
  languages (lines per language and the project's size), ownership, churn per
  file or directory, commit types and frequency. `name` picks it, `period` and
  `query` select the commits. Use for "how active", "how big", "who owns" and
  "where is the risk" questions. Parameters: `label?` (string), `limit?`
  (integer), `metric?` (string), `name` (string), `period?` (string), `query`
  (string), `repo?` (string), `rev?` (string).
- `list_insights`: The insights this server computes, each with a summary. Every
  one is a value of `name` for `insight`.
- `list_repos`: The repositories this server may read and which scope it was
  started with: name (pass it as `repo` to every other tool), HEAD, branch and
  newest commit. One that cannot be read shows `available: false` and why. Call
  this first when several are in scope.
- `list_tree`: Directory listing at a revision: name, kind (dir, file, symlink,
  submodule) and size per entry, one level deep. Use to explore the layout
  before `read_file`. Parameters: `path?` (string), `repo?` (string), `rev?`
  (string).
- `log`: Commit history, newest first, with paging. Pass `path` to see only
  commits that touched a file or directory ("who changed this and why"). Returns
  id, parents, author, committer and subject per commit plus `has_more`. For one
  commit's diff use `show_commit`. Parameters: `page?` (integer), `path?`
  (string), `per_page?` (integer), `repo?` (string), `rev?` (string).
- `read_file`: File content at a revision, read from git (not the working tree).
  Returns text, total line count and whether it was cut. Binary files return
  `binary: true` and no text. Use `start_line` and `limit` for large files. Not
  for directories: use `list_tree`. Parameters: `limit?` (integer), `path`
  (string), `repo?` (string), `rev?` (string), `start_line?` (integer).
- `repo_overview`: Orientation for a repository: name, HEAD, current branch and
  totals (commits, authors, files touched, lines added and removed, first and
  last commit time). Call this first, before drilling into history. Use `log`
  for the commits themselves. Parameters: `repo?` (string).
- `show_commit`: One commit: full message, changed files with additions and
  deletions and, by default, the diff hunks (capped by `max_lines`, `truncated`
  says when cut). Use after `log` or `blame` to learn what a change did.
  Parameters: `diff?` (boolean), `id` (string), `max_lines?` (integer), `repo?`
  (string).
- `worktree_diff`: Uncommitted changes against HEAD with their diffs, `scope`
  `staged`, `unstaged` or `all`. Reads this machine's working tree, so it is
  refused on a public server. Use to review work in progress before it is
  committed. Parameters: `max_lines?` (integer), `repo?` (string), `scope?`
  (string).

A trailing `?` marks an optional parameter.

Prompts are ready-made instructions an agent can load. They read nothing
themselves and tell the agent which tools to call.

- `review_change`: Review a change: the steps to order its files by risk with
  `compare` or `worktree_diff`, the `hotspots` and ownership insights, `blame`
  and `read_file`. Arguments: `base?`, `head?`, `repo?`, `worktree?`.
